name: DSR-Bench-challenge
description:
Dataset Card for "DSR-Bench-challenge"
	

DSR-Bench-challenge is a subset of DSR-Bench problems characterized by more complex and non-standard data structures, with tasks of multi-step reasoning. It contains 15 data structures and 450 questions. 
We tested 4 reasoning models (o4-mini, Gemini-2.5-Pro-preview, Claude-3.7-Sonnet, and DeepSeek-r1) and 5 instruction-tuned models (GPT-4.1, Gemini-2.0-flash, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, DeepSeek-v3, and Llama 3.3). None of the reasoning models tested… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/vitercik-lab/DSR-Bench-challenge.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate (correctness as judged by expected outputs/unit tests or exact-match of correct solutions)
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark for data-structure reasoning and multi-step coding tasks; limited adoption so far but of interest for LLM reasoning/code-evaluation researchers.
